items.what: The plan stops with a proposal: Defect (reports: kb/reports/state/review/results/kb/theory/a-citation-cannot-assert-more-fidelity-than-its-capture-preserved.md/kb/instructions/critique-note.md, kb/reports/state/review/results/kb/theory/a-citation-cannot-assert-more-fidelity-than-its-capture-preserved.md/kb/instructions/composition-friction-gate.md; finding kb/reports/state/review/results/kb/theory/a-citation-cannot-assert-more-fidelity-than-its-capture-preserved.md/frontmatter/title-body-alignment.md). The title 'A citation cannot assert more fidelity than its capture preserved' supports two readings that lead to different conclusions. Verification reading: a check can establish fidelity only relative to the evidence it compared. The body argues this, and under it the title is false as worded, because the opening says the assertion 'rests on the author's word' and the compared evidence may be an extract or nothing. Normative reading: a citing text may not claim more fidelity, strength or scope than its capture preserved. The dependents use this reading, and the body never develops it. Correcting the defect means retitling toward verification or developing the normative bound. Either way the opening and section framing are replaced (the synthesis, kb/reports/state/review/runs/v2/revise/kb/theory/a-citation-cannot-assert-more-fidelity-than-its-capture-preserved/20261118T160047Z/synthesis, reaches the same title-versus-survey choice). Either way the title claim that dependents rely on changes (role report: kb/reports/state/review/runs/v2/revise/kb/theory/a-citation-cannot-assert-more-fidelity-than-its-capture-preserved/20261118T160047Z/role). The dependents are kb/reference/adr/046-verbatim-quotes-are-validated-against-their-cited-source.md, kb/theory/a-note-is-an-atomic-step-relative-to-the-check-that-reads-it.md, kb/sources/rome-locating-and-editing-factual-associations-in-gpt.ingest.md, kb/sources/peters-chin-yee-llm-generalization-bias.ingest.md and kb/tags/claims-and-grounding-README.md. Route: commonplace-review run rewrite kb/theory/a-citation-cannot-assert-more-fidelity-than-its-capture-preserved.md --commission FILE, with the commission prepared with cp-skill-write-multistage. The commission should fix which reading the note asserts and where the dependents' normative use lives.
